confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are based on aggregated third-party price sources (cost-of-living sites, a Japan cafe price roundup, and an izakaya beer price roundup) and are mostly bounded ranges, so beer, coffee and meal figures are moderate confidence. Cocktail and wine_glass were not searched directly; they are estimated from the local beer price using a typical bar and restaurant markup, and are lower confidence. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Naha and Okinawa tourism pricing; no live booking pages or current listings were inspected. Yen-to-USD conversions use roughly 156 JPY per USD, implied by the sources, and yen rates may have moved since.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a Japanese regional tourist city, benchmarked against Japanese national and Tokyo food and drink prices with a slight Naha adjustment. Accommodation is benchmarked against Okinawa resort-city hotel and hostel tiers, with a summer July 2026 uplift.
